mapper.select: SELECT * FROM eb_flower_order_ext WHERE order_id = #{orderId} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM eb_flower_order_ext WHERE order_id = #{orderId} LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE eb_flower_order_ext SET current_stage = #{targetStage}, courier_name = CASE WHEN #{courierName} IS NULL THEN courier_name ELSE #{courierName} END, courier_phone = CASE WHEN #{courierPhone} IS NULL THEN courier_phone ELSE #{courierPhone} END, delivery_remark = CASE WHEN #{deliveryRemark} IS NULL THEN delivery_remark ELSE #{deliveryRemark} END, update_time = NOW() WHERE order_id = #{orderId}
mapper.select: SELECT ext.* FROM eb_flower_order_ext ext INNER JOIN eb_store_order original_order ON original_order.order_id = ext.order_id WHERE ext.current_stage = 'WAIT_PAY' AND (original_order.paid = 0 OR original_order.paid IS NULL) AND ext.reservation_expire_time < #{now} AND ext.reservation_released = 0 ORDER BY ext.reservation_expire_time ASC, ext.id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE eb_flower_order_ext SET reservation_released = 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND reservation_released = 0
UPDATE eb_flower_order_ext SET current_stage = 'WAIT_ACCEPT', update_time = NOW() WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND current_stage = 'WAIT_PAY'
mapper.sql: CASE WHEN original_order.paid=0 AND (original_order.is_del=1 OR ext.reservation_released=1) THEN 'CANCELLED' WHEN original_order.refund_status=2 THEN 'CLOSED' WHEN original_order.paid=0 THEN 'WAIT_PAY' ELSE ext.current_stage END

FROM eb_flower_order_ext ext INNER JOIN eb_store_order original_order ON original_order.order_id=ext.order_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT oid,MAX(create_time) AS completed_time FROM eb_store_order_status WHERE change_type='refund_price' GROUP BY oid) refund_log ON refund_log.oid=original_order.id

WHERE original_order.is_system_del=0
AND original_order.paid=1 AND original_order.refund_status=0 AND original_order.is_del=0
AND original_order.refund_status IN (1,3) AND ext.current_stage IN ('WAIT_PRODUCTION','PRODUCING') AND original_order.refund_status=0 AND original_order.paid=1 AND original_order.is_del=0 AND ext.current_stage IN ('WAIT_DELIVERY','DELIVERING') AND original_order.refund_status=0 AND original_order.paid=1 AND original_order.is_del=0
AND ()=#{filter.stage} AND original_order.refund_status NOT IN (1,3)
AND original_order.refund_status=0
AND original_order.refund_status=0 AND original_order.refund_status IN (1,3) AND original_order.refund_status=2 AND original_order.refund_price < original_order.pay_price AND original_order.refund_status=2
AND (ext.order_id LIKE CONCAT('%',#{filter.keyword},'%') OR ext.recipient_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{filter.keyword},'%') OR ext.recipient_phone LIKE CONCAT('%',#{filter.keyword},'%') OR original_order.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{filter.keyword},'%'))
AND original_order.paid=1 AND original_order.pay_time >= #{filter.startDate} AND original_order.pay_time < DATE_ADD(#{filter.endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
AND ((original_order.refund_reason_time >= #{filter.startDate} AND original_order.refund_reason_time < DATE_ADD(#{filter.endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)) OR (original_order.refund_status=2 AND refund_log.completed_time >= #{filter.startDate} AND refund_log.completed_time < DATE_ADD(#{filter.endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)))
AND original_order.refund_status=2 AND refund_log.completed_time >= #{filter.startDate} AND refund_log.completed_time < DATE_ADD(#{filter.endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
AND original_order.create_time >= #{filter.startDate} AND original_order.create_time < DATE_ADD(#{filter.endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
AND original_order.refund_status IN (1,2,3) AND original_order.refund_status=2 AND original_order.paid=1
mapper.select:
SELECT ext.order_id AS order_no,ext.current_stage,ext.recipient_name,ext.recipient_phone, ext.delivery_address_snapshot AS delivery_address,ext.delivery_date,ext.slot_id, original_order.pay_price,original_order.total_price,original_order.total_num,original_order.paid, original_order.refund_status,original_order.refund_price,original_order.create_time,original_order.pay_time, original_order.refund_reason_time AS refund_apply_time,refund_log.completed_time AS refund_completed_time, original_order.refund_reason_wap AS refund_reason,() AS order_state, product.product_name,product.image AS product_image
LEFT JOIN (SELECT order_id,product_name,image,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY id) AS item_rank FROM eb_store_order_info) product ON product.order_id=original_order.id AND product.item_rank=1
ORDER BY original_order.create_time DESC,original_order.id DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count,COALESCE(SUM(original_order.paid=1),0) AS paid_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN original_order.paid=1 THEN original_order.pay_price ELSE 0 END),0) AS paid_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN original_order.refund_status IN (1,3) THEN original_order.refund_price ELSE 0 END),0) AS pending_refund_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN original_order.refund_status=2 THEN original_order.refund_price ELSE 0 END),0) AS refunded_amount

SELECT CASE WHEN original_order.refund_status IN (1,3) THEN 'AFTER_SALE' ELSE () END AS stage,COUNT(*) AS quantity
GROUP BY stage
SELECT MAX(create_time) FROM eb_store_order_status WHERE oid=#{orderId} AND change_type='refund_price'
